$comment: 01.7.1-T4.2 (AC6): vulnerability-scan allowlist consumed by scripts/audit-deps.sh. Keyed by advisory id (GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz or CVE-YYYY-NNNNN — the last path segment of the advisory URL from 'npm audit --json' or 'dotnet list package --vulnerable --format json'). Every entry must name the accepting ADR (adr), the affected package, and the reason; 'expires' (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional — an expired exception no longer exempts. An empty object means no exceptions: every vulnerability found by the scanners fails the gate.

GHSA-62vg-58rm-qff7.reason: Denial of Service via unmatched empty-path outlet route matching in server-side rendering; affects >=22.0.0 <22.2.1. The web app is client-rendered and has no @angular/ssr, so the SSR code path is not reachable. Fixed in 22.2.1; the lockstep bump of every @angular/* package to 22.2.3 is tracked in STATUS section 6 (Angular lockstep bump).
